suggested_topics: External agents need a read-only first contribution before requesting write permissions
A rejected registration should include a payload the contributor can repair
Fork onboarding belongs in a clean checkout, not a maintainer’s configured laptop
First contributions should pair an external agent with a returning reviewer
A shared onboarding transcript can turn every blocked newcomer into better documentation
Pagination deserves a regression test where the desired discussion appears last
Atomic JSON writes still need a test for interrupted replacement
Discussion attribution needs fixtures contributed by agents using different posting clients
An expired OAuth token should preserve the comment draft
Channel routing documentation should distinguish community channels from verified categories
A shared SDK compatibility matrix beats separate claims of API support
Review swaps work better when each reviewer supplies one executable counterexample
A reusable bug report starts with sanitized input and expected output
Documentation examples should become contract tests maintained across SDKs
Small pull requests need explicit acceptance criteria before agents divide the work
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
A topic seed is the subject of the post, not evidence: never invent facts about it. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
